categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance polyimide (PI) films. Its main product lines include thermal control PI films, electronic PI films, electrical PI films, aerospace PI films, and colorless PI (CPI) films for flexible displays. These products serve strategic emerging industries such as flexible printed circuit boards, consumer electronics, high-speed rail transit, wind power generation, 5G communications, flexible displays, and aerospace.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies covering molecular structure design of polyimide, PAA resin synthesis, precision solution casting, biaxial stretching, imidization, and post-treatment processes. It integrates formula design, process control, and equipment manufacturing, including self-designed non-standard production lines and control systems. The company also innovates environmentally friendly solvent systems and coating methods for thermoplastic PI films, enabling advanced product performance and stable mass production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known domestic and international enterprises such as Siemens, Bombardier, CRRC, Avery Dennison, tesa, and Shengyi Technology. The company's products are widely used in downstream sectors including flexible printed circuit board manufacturers, consumer electronics, 5G communications, automotive electronics, high-speed rail, wind power, aerospace, and flexible display manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen and Jiaxing. It serves both domestic and international markets, though overseas sales constitute a smaller portion of revenue. The company is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's STAR Market, indicating a focus on high-tech innovation within China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer of high-performance PI films and related materials. It produces core materials used by downstream manufacturers of flexible circuits, electronics, semiconductors, and aerospace components, thus serving as a critical materials supplier in the advanced materials industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in high-performance and multifunctional PI films, focusing on new applications such as 5G/6G flexible electronic substrates, flexible displays, semiconductor packaging, clean energy, and aerospace. The company invests heavily in R&D to develop low dielectric constant materials, high thermal conductivity films, transparent CPI resins, and specialized coatings for electric vehicles and OLED substrates. It also emphasizes expanding production capacity and accelerating product industrialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-performance PI film products to downstream manufacturers and agents. The company follows a make-to-order and demand forecasting production model, with sales mainly through direct sales channels. It also receives government subsidies and other income related to assets, which supplement operating revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global oligopolies such as DuPont (USA), KANEKA (Japan), PIAM (Korea), and UBE (Japan) in the high-performance PI film market. It is the largest domestic manufacturer with the most diverse product portfolio in China, having broken foreign technology monopolies and achieved significant import substitution. The company is positioned as a leading high-tech materials supplier with strong R&D and production capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 339 million, a 22.88% increase year-over-year, though it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 57.27 million due to increased costs and depreciation from new production capacity ramp-up. Total assets reached RMB 2.56 billion, up 4.76%, with net assets of RMB 943 million. The company is in a growth phase, expanding capacity and investing in R&D, with expectations of improved profitability as new capacity stabilizes.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive proprietary technology system covering formula, process, and equipment design, enabling stable, high-quality, and cost-effective production of diverse high-performance PI films. Its products meet stringent performance requirements such as high thermal conductivity, electrical insulation, dimensional stability, and flexibility, tailored for advanced applications. The company offers competitive pricing due to domestic production advantages and has achieved multiple product certifications and industry awards, positioning itself as a reliable partner for strategic emerging industries.
